items.headline: No. 1 Ohio State sees 20-point lead evaporate in 4th quarter
items.description: No. 1 Ohio State controlled the game for more than three quarters but quickly unraveled in the fourth, dropping a 24-23 decision to No. 4 Texas. "This one hurts," coach Ryan Day told reporters.

items.headline: Highlight: No. 4 Texas grinds No. 1 Ohio State to a halt for epic comeback
items.description: Arch Manning throws for 196 yards and a touchdown as Hollywood Smothers score two touchdowns on the ground, including the game winner in the final minute of the 24-23 Longhorns' win.
